user.description: Add Daylight Zones. Zones are added afterwards, from the integration page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Daylight Zones is already set up.

lights.title: Light limits
lights.description: Maximum and minimum brightness per light, as % of its full brightness.

error.light_in_other_zone: One of these lights already belongs to another zone.
error.lux_sensor_required: Choose a lux sensor, or use the sun as source.

options.daylight: Follows daylight (evening ramp, optional boost, cosy, morning ramp)
options.fixed: Fixed level whenever the zone is on

options.window: Off and on times: fade to off, come back at the on time
options.switch_off: Off time only: fade out and switch the zone off

auto_on.name: Turn on
auto_on.description: Switch auto on: follow the sun and manage the lights.

auto_off.name: Turn off
auto_off.description: Switch auto off: lights off, and the zone leaves them alone.

until.name: Until
until.description: noon: switch auto back on at the next solar noon.

override_on.name: Set override
override_on.description: Lights at a set level, also when auto is off; for example for visitors.

level.name: Level
level.description: Override level; leave empty to keep the zone's override level.

until.name: Until
until.description: next_phase, the next solar noon, or after a duration.

override_toggle.name: Toggle override
override_toggle.description: Switch the override on (at the zone's override level, until the next solar noon) or off.
